text:
sara_finance: AP flagged NOV-INV-2026-332 for NovusEdge 12 no PO matched and vendor disputes the rate on one line. Invoice total $9,840 (seat fees $1,200, usage $8,640). Need owner for approval + PO?

mike_procure: Checking PO registry. We have PO-77211 for a pilot (term limited). Nothing for monthly usage. :mag_right:

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Invoice NOV-INV-2026-332 uploaded by sara_finance. Status -> routing_hold (missing PO).

anya_ops: If it's runtime spend this should be cost center 349-ML-Platform. @devon_prod, do you own NovusEdge?

devon_prod: I do. I can approve a retro PO but I need the per-region hours and rates to validate. Also vendor wrote in the cover email that they applied a special "intro" rate but invoice shows standard rate. Can you paste the CSV, @sara_finance?

sara_finance: Pasting vendor CSV snippet they attached (cols vendor provided):

```
date,region,hours,rate_per_hour,amount
2026-02-02,us-east,400,10.00,4000.00
2026-02-03,us-east,440,10.00,4400.00
2026-02-10,us-west,124,10.00,1240.00
```

mike_procure: Vendor email said "intro price $8/hr for first 500h", but CSV shows $10/hr everywhere. Vendor_bot, did they send a revised pricing note? @vendor_bot

vendor_bot: SYSTEM (NovusEdge): Confirming account exec emailed a one-line credit note offering "intro pricing applied to first 500 hours = $8/hr" but treasury asked vendor to issue a combined invoice; credit note was sent as separate PDF.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: AP note: "invoice total $9,840 vs CSV unadjusted total $9,640. Discrepancy $200 — appears related to price variance on intro hours."

anya_ops: So math check: CSV total = 4000+4400+1240 = $9,640. Invoice shows $9,840 which is $200 higher. Where did extra $200 come from?

devon_prod: Probably vendor applied full price for some hours. Procurement prefers vendor reissue with PO on header and consolidated credit memo. For this cycle we can accept an internal retro PO and clear payment. I'll approve after Procurement creates PO-R-2026-511 and vendor confirms pricing.

mike_procure: Creating PO now. PO-R-2026-511 created (supplier NovusEdge) 12 routing to devon_prod, note: retro PO for Feb usage and requires vendor to reissue with pricing confirmation.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: PO PO-R-2026-511 created by mike_procure. Invoice NOV-INV-2026-332 linked to PO-R-2026-511. Payment hold set until approval and vendor confirmation.

sara_finance: I've asked vendor to reissue combined invoice with PO-R-2026-511 on header and the intro pricing applied. They replied "reissue ETA 24h".

devon_prod: Approving contingent on reissued invoice matching the CSV with intro discount applied. Approving PO-R-2026-511 in principle.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Approval recorded (conditional). Payment hold remains until reissued invoice is uploaded. Finance to post interim accrual.

sara_finance: Noted. I'll create the accrual and follow up with vendor for reissue. Closing loop here after reissue uploads and payment posts. :white_check_mark:
